title: Publishing a published story is silently blocked by the new checklist, and scripts cannot tell
description: 2026-11-08: a script ran papyrus ops content publish for 76 published stories after saving edited versions. Each call was rejected with 'content publish failed [checklist-open]' (review steps open on legacy published stories) but the script only looked for an ok:false marker and logged success, so nothing went live. Needs: a non-zero exit code and a distinct machine-readable code for checklist-open; a --json result; and an owner decision on whether a text-only edit of an already-published story should reopen the review lenses, research and outline steps at all. checklist-backfill leaves the four review lenses open on published stories, so every edit of a legacy story hits this.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Branch feature/PPY-2745c1-publish-stages, PR https://github.com/AnthusAI/Papyrus/pull/1304 (stacked on #1302). Verified with fakes only (pytest + behave, see PR); nothing run against real AWS. Needs deploy: content-actions function per site.
